cases.claim: The scheduler capability is exact, internal, and source bound.
Forward and backward working-time arithmetic are exact inverses across recurring gaps.
Named-zone membership counts exact elapsed instants across daylight-saving gaps and overlaps.
Validity and capacity replacements produce generic finite and partial availability.
All required resources are acquired atomically over their common progress intervals.
Calendar interruption releases allocations and stable resume precedes new work.
Precedence profile version 2 is exact and excludes cross-task contention.
Parallel-SGS version 2 constructs a finite-capacity schedule and remains optimal false.
Active remaining work is already selected and conflicting active capacity fails closed.
Utilization is derived from exact allocated and available unit-seconds.
Static absence and bounded horizon exhaustion remain distinct unavailable causes.
Capacity overrides cannot exceed the selected nominal capacity or rewrite source.
Continuous Grammar 8 compatibility remains delegated and not reimplemented.
Results are deterministic and frozen while active public catalogs remain unchanged.
